game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: In Sundial Plaza, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round, sandstorms strike the bazaar gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clues value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from sandstorms in Sundial Plaza: keep the clues meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: clues drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clues changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Sundial Plaza.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while clues > 0.
